{{Quote|Has it occurred to you that you're setting up a third government here?|Wedge Antilles to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>}}
The '''Jedi Coalition''' was a coalition government, between both the [[New Jedi Order]] and the [[Alliance-in-exile]], as well as the [[Maw Irregular Fleet]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], formed by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], after the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]], in response to [[Darth Caedus]]' rule of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

The Coalition's primary objective was to remove Caedus from power in order to peacefully end the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
===Withdrawal at Kuat===
{{Quote|The Jedi can support you no longer.|Luke Skywalker to Darth Caedus|<ref name="inferno" />}}
The [[Battle of Kuat (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kuat]] had been going on for nearly a week; Darth Caedus' plan to finally win the war was to have the Jedi in their [[StealthX]] starfighters launch a shadow bomb run on the [[Confederation Fleet]] and destroy it.<ref name="inferno" />

While talking with his fellow Jedi, Luke Skywalker tried to come up with a plan of action for the Jedi to take. There was nothing to arrest Jacen Solo for, and Skywalker didn't want to support the Confederation. However, Skywalker knew that the Jedi couldn't allow Solo to push them any further&mdash;something needed to be done; Skywalker asked the Jedi when that line was crossed, but the rest of the Jedi stated that the line wasn't crossed until he said so.<ref name="inferno" />

Then, [[Cilghal]] arrived and told Skywalker that [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] had been killed and that it was [[Ben Skywalker]] who did it. Luke immediately confronted Jacen and informed him that the Jedi would no longer support him. After Jacen threatened to kill the Jedi he held hostage on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], Luke returned to his StealthX and left.<ref name="inferno" />

It seemed, to Caedus, that the Jedi's withdrawal from the Alliance was not official, and was ready to use them to end the war. After the Jedi launched, he reached out to them, urging them to attack, but, they responded with waves of anger, and left the system. Caedus realized that the Jedi had deserted him, and ordered that the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] be [[Invasion of the New Jedi Temple|occupied]] and the Jedi on Ossus to be [[Battle of Ossus (Second Galactic Civil War)|killed]].<ref name="inferno" />

Even though the Alliance eventually won at [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], the battle didn't have the intended impact on the [[Confederation]], and both sides suffered heavy casualties.<ref name="inferno" />

===The Battle of Kashyyyk===
[[File:LukeInferno.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Skywalker before fighting Darth Caedus.]]
{{Quote|We have come to Kashyyyk to ask the Wookiees to join us.|Luke Skywalker to the Rock Council|<ref name="inferno" />}}
After Kuat, Skywalker led the Council Masters to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] so they could address the [[Rock Council]]. He informed them that the assassination of Cal Omas was arranged by Solo and requested that the Wookiees join their Coalition against him.

After being informed by Ben that the Jedi were on Kashyyyk, Caedus departed for Kashyyyk to give the Wookiees an opportunity to turn over the Jedi, even though he knew they would refuse. When his [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|fleet]] arrived, a squadron of [[Owool Interceptor|Owools]] approached and heard his demands.

Caedus's true intentions, however, were to make the Confederation abort their military campaign towards Coruscant. After the Wookiees lied about harboring the Jedi, Caedus had justification for attacking the planet, which would attract the Confederation away from the core, and force them to help the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. He began an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the planet. The Owools led by [[Lowbacca]] immediately launched a [[Jedi shadow bomb]] on the ''Anakin Solo''{{'s}} bridge. At the same time, Ben Skywalker tried to kill Caedus. Both Lowbacca and Ben had failed to kill him and Caedus immobilized Ben with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and put him in the [[Embrace of Pain]], hoping to turn him to the dark side.<ref name="inferno" />

On Kashyyyk, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] left for [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] to gain the support of Queen Mother [[Tenel Ka Djo]]. Meanwhile, Skywalker led a wing of StealthXs in an assault on the ''Anakin Solo'''s [[long-range turbolaser]] batteries that were firing on the planet. The Wookiee fleet was still organizing, which left the Jedi as the planet's only defenders. Caedus flew out in his own StealthX and engaged his sister, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]], and his uncle.

After being shot down by friendly fire, Skywalker faked his own death and landed on the ''Anakin Solo''. After disabling the long-range turbolasers, he engaged Caedus in a fierce duel. The [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)#Jedi raid|fight]] between [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] was extremely vicious, and the upper hand shifted back and forth until the younger Skywalker escaped the Embrace, came to the aid of his father, and stabbed Caedus with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. Since Skywalker believed that if his son killed Caedus, the latter would fall to the dark side; thus, he took Ben and departed.<ref name="inferno" />

===Parley on the ''Dragon Queen''===
{{Quote|We can bring Jacen down by more subtle means. Once he's no longer in charge of the Alliance, I'm confident all parties will work out their differences in a more amicable manner.|Luke Skywalker to Admiral Babo|<ref name="inferno" />}}
[[File:JacenCaedus.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Darth Caedus, the target of the Jedi Coalition]]
After the duel, Tenel Ka Djo arrived with her forces, and attacked Caedus' fleet, after he denied her offer of surrender. With an overwhelming amount of enemies attacking, it seemed that the [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Fifth Fleet]] would be destroyed. But the arrival of [[Alema Rar]] and her [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] combined with Caedus's own [[Battle meditation/Legends|Sith Battle Meditation]] gave him the power to push through the Bothan forces and escape.

Afterwards, the Confederation and Jedi leaders met on the ''[[Dragon Queen]]'' to discuss the stance of the Jedi, the Wookiees, and the Hapans in the war. The Jedi stated that they would not side with the Confederation, but would form their own faction dedicated to removing Solo from power, and, after achieving their goal, would rejoin the Galactic Alliance. Both the Hapans and Wookiees decided to side with the Jedi. The Jedi Coalition was officially formed, and agreed not interfere with the Confederation, or their plans against Solo.<ref name="inferno" />

===Ambush in the Undercity===
{{Quote|Care to surrender, Colonel Solo?''"<br />"''Not to a traitor.|Kyle Katarn and Darth Caedus|<ref name="fury" />}}
After [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Kashyyyk]], Luke took Ben as his apprentice and set up a temporary [[Jedi Outpost|base]] for the Jedi Coalition on Endor. Knowing that action needed to be taken against Jacen, he charged [[Kyp Durron]] with planning a mission. Durron formed a plan to capture Caedus outside the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] and escape in the undercity with their captive while a fake escape shuttle lead any security away. Durron and Luke agreed that if they couldn't capture Jacen they would kill him. After meeting [[Seha Dorvald]], the team's guide through the undercity and a former spy for Jacen, he approved the plan. Durron wanted Luke to lead the ambush, but Luke refused because he believed he would attack in hatred and appointed [[Kyle Katarn]] as the leader. The team was made up of Katarn, [[Valin Horn]], [[Thann Mithric]], [[Kolir Hu'lya|Kolir Hu'lya,]] and Dorvald. They traveled to Coruscant and planned for Dorvald to plant a tracking device on Caedus' cloak so they could track his movements. The mission was only a partial success. Dorvald was able to plant the device on Caedus but at a price. Jacen was now a powerful [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and emerged from the [[Undercity Ambush|ambush]] victorious after [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitating]] Mithric and stabbing Katarn through the chest. Dorvald and Horn managed to drag Katarn to safety and escaped with the rest of the team.<ref name="fury" />

===Destroying Centerpoint Station===
[[File:Benfury.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Ben Skywalker during the Battle of Centerpoint Station.]]
{{Quote|It's inconceivable that he would not make an all-out effort to capture the station and have in his possession the most powerful weapon in the galaxy. We're not going to let the Corellians have it, and we're not going to let Jacen have it.|Luke Skywalker to General [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]|<ref name="fury" />}}
During a visit from [[Tenel Ka Djo]], Luke Skywalker offered to retrieve her daughter [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]] from Jacen who was using her to keep the Hapans in the war. Luke planned to destroy [[Centerpoint Station]], which he believed was too dangerous for any organization to control. The Jedi taskforce would infiltrate both Centerpoint Station and the ''Anakin Solo'' where Allana was being held. During the battle Jedi Master Kyp Durron and his team infiltrated Centerpoint disguised as GAG troopers while Luke, his son and [[Saba Sebatyne]] distracted Jacen as Han and Leia retrieved Allana. [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and the [[Rakehell Squadron|Rakehells]] defended the transports and shuttles containing the strike teams. The Skywalkers would board the ''Anakin Solo'' using [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu's]] shuttle.

The Jedi task force dropped out of hyperspace near Centerpoint Station. Rakehell Squadron moved toward the ''Anakin Solo'' shooting at the ''[[Reveille]]'' so the shuttle would be allowed to land in the Star Destroyer. As the shuttle landed inside the hangar, Celchu alerted GAG forces that Jedi were onboard. Caedus immediately felt the presences of the Jedi and sent [[YVH-Series battle droid|YVH droids]] to stall them. Rakehell Squadron repeated their previous tactic with a false strike on [[Broadside (shuttle)|''Broadside'']] which gave them authorization to land on Centerpoint. Aboard the transport was Doctor [[Toval Seyah]] and Durron who would disable and destroy Centerpoint. As Luke's team entered the ''Anakin Solo'''s bridge Caedus had his YVH droids engage them. Meanwhile, Han, Leia, and [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella]] crawled through secret shafts on the ''Anakin Solo'' to get to Allana without Caedus knowing. They finally found Allana and headed towards the ''Millennium Falcon''. During the fight on the bridge Darth Caedus saw his droids being destroyed so he used the Force to throw Sebatyne into one of the pits which was on fire then slammed her into the port-side wall. The team was forced to retreat when Caedus left after [[Force sense/Legends|sensing]] Allana being taken away. Luke warned Leia that Jacen was on his way and they headed towards the air lock. Luke, Ben, and Sebatyne, being chased by Caedus, finally arrived and left the ''Anakin Solo'' with Allana. Meanwhile Doctor Seyah sabotaged Centerpoint Station which led to its destruction.<ref name="fury" />

===Allies gained at Fondor===
[[File:Fondor_EotECR.png|thumb|right|200px|Fondor, the capital of the Coalition following the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]]]
{{Quote|Colonel Solo clearly represents the greatest threat to Fondor and the rest of the galaxy, uniting against him is the most important thing. He may well be back to finish the job he started, and if he doesn't, then I would like to commit the forces we have left to finishing him.|Shas Vadde, committing Fondor to the Coalition|<ref name="revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>}}
After the Jedi escaped with Allana, Darth Caedus demanded to know how the Jedi boarded the ''Anakin Solo.'' When [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Patra Tebut]] admitted that although she followed protocol it was her fault, the Dark Lord [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force choked]] her to death in front of the entire bridge crew. This incident shocked the entire Galactic Alliance Navy and convinced [[Cha Niathal]] to begin communicating with Luke Skywalker in secret. Niathal gave Luke details on the upcoming invasion of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], revealing to Luke that his nephew was a Sith Lord and that he had enlisted the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] for the upcoming battle. Luke Skywalker warned the [[Fondorian]]s of the space mines to be placed around the planet which led to the [[Nonvideor-class minelayer|minelayer crew]] being killed. This greatly affected the battle against the Alliance forces as the mines could have taken out many ships quickly and reduced Alliance casualties. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] did not directly fight in the battle; they only protected the unarmed civilians working in the orbital yards and hid the Fondorian navy until they ambushed the Alliance/Imperial fleet. After the Fondorians surrendered, the battle still ended up being a major victory for the Coalition after Caedus refused to accept the surrender and continued to bombard Fondor. Admiral Niathal attempted to relieve Caedus of his rank and the Galactic Alliance split into two. One side was the official GA that supported Darth Caedus which included a large majority of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]]. The other was Niathal's [[Alliance-in-exile]] which was made up of defectors from the [[Third Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Third]] and [[Fourth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Fouth]] fleets. They joined the Coalition along with the [[Maw Irregular Fleet]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] under [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Luke Skywalker negotiated with the [[Shas Vadde|president]] of Fondor to use the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] as the Coalition's base of operations, making a place for all enemies of Darth Caedus to rally.<ref name="revelation" />

===Reunion===
The Coalition ended when the [[Sword of the Jedi]] faced off against, and killed, her brother, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], bringing the war to an end. Everyone returned to their respective factions; splitting the Jedi Coalition back into the Galactic Alliance and the New Jedi Order once again.<ref name="Invincible" />
